study: Wijekumar/Meyer/Lei 2017, ITSS (Intelligent Tutoring System for the Structure Strategy) web-based reading-comprehension program + teacher PD, grade 7 RCT, J. Educ. Psych. 109(6):741-760
eval_evidence: Authored by the ITSS developers (Wijekumar & Meyer, the program's creators, on the IES ITSS efficacy/replication grant) who conducted the evaluation of their own program.
developer_evidence: The ~3-hour start-of-year teacher PD was 'delivered by the research team to the intervention teachers' (the ITSS developers/research staff), who also provided biweekly progress reports.
cascade_evidence: The research/developer team delivered the PD directly to the intervention (language-arts) teachers; no train-the-trainer / lead-teacher intermediary.
counterfactual_evidence: Control teachers 'used the school's standard language arts curriculum' with no ITSS (business as usual).
coaching_evidence: PD was a single ~3-hour start-of-year session plus biweekly written progress reports; no ongoing in-class coaching/observation cycles of teachers in their classrooms.
student_dose_evidence: ITSS is a web-based student-facing software program used 1-2 sessions/week (~30-45 min) as a partial substitute for the language arts period — a substantial student-facing software dose beyond the teacher's regular instruction.
maturity_evidence: Single 6-7 month school-year intervention with a single end-of-year post-test wave; implemented for one year with no prior-implementation/maturity axis.
